column1: # testguard config for the ci-policy (python-legs) row of .github/workflows/ci-fast.yml.
# Every package the row's go test runs is a suite; every test that runs has
# an empty file under the baseline directory; skips are ledgered here by test.
# The record lines run the row's go test as ci-fast.yml's ci-policy step does
# (keep them the same); `go run ./tools/testguard baseline --config THIS` runs
# them and writes the entries for the tests that ran and are not listed.
